  •  Slightly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

  •  Slightly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly faster draw time

  •  Increases handling speed

Heavy and consistent. 
  •  Greatly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly decreases stability

Aerodynamic and light. 
  •  Slightly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Natural Fletching

perks.name: Straight Fletching

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.desc: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.desc: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

perks.name: Built to Blast
perks.desc: Gain aim assist, stability, and flinch resistance while you have Woven Mail, Frost Armor, or Void Overshield.

perks.name: Tunnel Vision
perks.desc: Reloading after defeating a target greatly increases target acquisition and aim down sight speed for a short duration.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Attrition Orbs
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

perks.name: Kinetic Tremors
perks.desc: Sustained kinetic damage to a target emits a shockwave that damages any nearby targets.

perks.name: Adagio
perks.desc: After defeating a target, this weapon fires, charges, or draws more slowly and deals increased damage for a brief time.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.desc: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: High Ground
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks.

perks.name: Vanguard Determination
perks.desc: After using your class ability, final blows with this weapon grant you bonus damage resistance.

perks.name: Häkke Breach Armaments
perks.desc:
This weapon deals increased damage against vehicles and constructs.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

perks.name: Tenacity
perks.desc: When targets are nearby, final blows grant weapon damage, reload speed, and handling until the wielder's death.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 153 from 9 September 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/6iEksMDGzT5euNuMAEqnVm?si=a9bf49987cdb441a) with @CourtProjects and @Saint_Kabr (PvE PvE-PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for dealing with Minor adds in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content. Mercury-A is the first of a new bow subfamily - high-impact longbows - whose frame intrinsic is to overpenetrate targets, like Armor-Piercing Rounds. There aren't really any peers to assess against - the weapon has higher impact and stability (so a longer perfect draw window), but longer draw time and worse attributes in every other respect, although that's helped at Tier 4/5 when bowstring and arrow perks are enhanced - see https://d2foundry.gg/w/2838279629 for how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. You'll definitely need to use the bowstring perk to improve Draw Time, and the arrow perk to recover any lost Accuracy or improve Reload Speed to improve the time before you're ready to shoot again. For an all-round roll there's a useful interaction in the trait perk combination of Attrition Orbs to spawn a power orb after 5 hits within 5s of each other, to help super generation and proc armour mods and Kinetic Tremors to emit three 6m Aoe kinetic shockwaves after 3 crit hits (2 when enhanced) emits three 6m AoE kinetic shockwaves after 3 crit hits (2 when enhanced) which are treated as weapon damage and inherit damage boosts, and also procs weapon effects like proccing Attrition Orbs' orb generation. The Tenacity Origin trait stacks up to ×20 on kills, providing +2.5 Handling and Reload Speed and an extra 0.5% damage per stack (max +50 Handling and Reload, and ×1.1 damage boost) until you die. Vanguard Vindication provides up to 3 stacks of ×0.98/0.96/0.94 damage reduction for 10s, for kills within 20s of using a class ability. There's also Häkke Breach Armaments for an additional ×1.15 damage against vehicles, ×1.3 damage against constructs and ×1.45 damage against stasis crystals. Recommended MW: Draw Time, with your preferred choice of mod/enhanced mod to boost mag size, weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.
